sessions.title: First pass allocation
sessions.goal: Build a controlled paycheck input, a minimal rules editor, and a pure allocate(paycheck, rules) for fixed and percent rules; render results that update as you type.

criteria.check: sc-main renders a row for 'Rent' with amount 300.00 after entering paycheck 1000 and a fixed rule of 300 to 'Rent'
sc-main renders a row for 'Food' with amount 50.00 after entering paycheck 500 and a 10% rule to 'Food'
sc-main renders one results row per distinct envelope after adding two envelopes with any rules
On sc-main, changing the Paycheck input from 400 to 600 renders updated totals immediately

cuts.hint: Apply every fixed rule to its target envelope and add the fixed amount into `out` without touching percent rules.
For each percent rule, add paycheck * percent/100 into the matching envelope in `out` using the paycheck as the base.
Build `rows` from the current allocation so each envelope name and its numeric amount appear as a list row.
Read the input event and parse its numeric value into `nextPaycheck` so the paycheck state can be updated.

sessions.title: Caps, ordering and rationale
sessions.goal: Add rule priority and caps, implement remainder distribution with a stable order, and generate a per-envelope trace shown in the UI.

criteria.check: On sc-main, a 50% rule with a cap of 100 applied to paycheck 1000 renders amount 100.00 for its envelope
On sc-main, with two rules for the same envelope at different priorities, the rationale panel renders the higher-priority rule's line before the lower-priority one
On sc-main, with remainder 30 and three eligible envelopes at equal priority, the Results list renders each of those three increased by 10.00
On sc-main, expanding an envelope renders at least two rationale lines that include rule identifiers and applied amounts
On sc-main, after reloading the page with identical inputs, the Results list renders the same per-envelope amounts and the same remainder distribution order
On sc-main, clicking the rationale toggle shows the rationale panel; clicking it again hides the panel

cuts.hint: Sort the given rules into `ordered` so higher priority comes first and ties are resolved stably by rule id.
Limit any percent-with-cap contribution so the envelope’s addition into `out` never exceeds its declared cap.
Spread the leftover amount into `updated` across eligible envelopes in a fixed, repeatable order until no remainder or all caps are met.
Build `trace` entries that record before, applied and after amounts per rule with a short reason string.
Build `details` for the selected envelope so its rationale text lines render under that row when expanded.

sessions.title: Compare, undo/redo and shareable URLs
sessions.goal: Compare two rule sets side-by-side, add undo/redo to the editor, and encode/decode scenario state in the URL.

criteria.check: sc-compare renders headings 'Scenario A' and 'Scenario B' and shows one editor and one results list under each heading
On sc-compare, after entering different rules into A and B, the page renders different totals per column
On sc-compare, after pressing Undo, the active editor shows the previous value
On sc-compare, after pressing Redo, the active editor shows the value that was undone
On sc-compare, opening a copied share URL displays an identical scenario in both the editor and results
On sc-compare, changing any scenario field updates the browser URL and the visible share link to show the current state

cuts.hint: Build `rowsB` so Scenario B renders its own results list independently from Scenario A.
Produce `next` from the current state and an action so UNDO steps back one past state and REDO steps forward when available.
Encode the current scenario into `url` as a query string that fully describes the scenario.
Parse the browser location and fill `restored` with a complete scenario object so the UI can initialize from it.
Build `shareHref` from the current browser location so a copyable link always matches the visible scenario.
